datePolicy: Retains original November 6, 2026 task-date/access labels. Requests occurred November 5, 2026 UTC and Toronto time in the same session, not a later refresh. Trip-planner and two unselected-listing locators have no explicit source-specific access date and remain unknown. Editing is not a fresh legal, fare, price, vacancy or listing check; no publication date invented.
uncertainties: Not legal advice. RTA and human-rights coverage depend on the actual owner/family sharing, resident-tenant/roommate and residence agreement. Voluntary advance-rent case law was not verified. Reader must recheck rules and seek student legal help before paying.

Exact programme/campus, age and gender are unspecified. Nigerian profile is unchanged. All 13 ads are dated examples, not inventory or September 2027 availability. No landlord contact, identity/ownership authentication, property inspection or licence verification occurred.

Missing utilities, lease terms and move-in dates remain unknown. Advertised gender restrictions are not endorsed or assessed for legality. Shuter ads are separate floors at one property; final two ads are shared bedrooms/dorm beds, not private rooms.
508 Concord is one whole-basement offer plus 30% house bills, not a typical apartment price. Internet, approval/safety and winter bills unverified; all-in cost may exceed CAD 1,300.

The George price covers September 2026–April 2027; 2027–28 fees/dates/agreement unverified. Agreement PDF and cancellation-policy download unsuccessful; visa-refusal release/refund terms unknown. Parkside meal-plan price unknown; HOEM rate year and applicable dates/terms unverified.

All monthly figures except cited TTC pass are estimates. Landing/setup/temporary-stay amounts and 5–10% reserve are assumptions, not mandatory fees or forecasts. No NGN/CAD exchange rate assumed. Tuition, programme supplies, health coverage, flights and immigration costs excluded.

Commutes are geographic estimates, not timed itineraries. TTC prices are dated; 40-trip cap from September 1, 2027 is planned, and CAD 132 assumes unchanged fares. Student eligibility, ID issuance and 2027–28 prices need recheck.

2027 rent guideline does not cap new-tenancy starting rent and does not establish a 2028 increase. Post-November 15, 2018 exemption and special AC adjustments require actual facts. Lease end/notice rules have exceptions.

Original research used public retrieval and some readable-page fallbacks; separate fresh incognito cross-checks were not every source's access context. No personal sign-ins were imported. No sources were externally refreshed for this local draft.
